Synopsis:
This is an emotional romantic action drama centered around Seenu and Junnu, two childhood soulmates who are deeply attached but tragically separated when Junnu's family relocates to Delhi. Years later, Seenu is adopted by a wealthy, loving couple who rename him Avinash, and he uses his exceptional parkour skills to navigate the city, while Junnu—now known as Priya—grows up still yearning for her childhood friend. After exactly 14 years, 3 months, and 11 days, destiny finally reconnects them through a brief phone call; however, right at that crucial moment, a ruthless street gang snatches Avinash’s phone. The core of the film follows a high-octane, single-day race against time as Avinash relentlessly battles the criminal network through spectacular chases and action sequences across the city to retrieve his phone, eventually leading to a dramatic airport climax where he and Priya finally recognize each other's true identities and reunite.
